materialization_rule: Where a vector supplies *_record_additions, form the complete record by a shallow object union of the named fingerprint_preimage and additions; their key sets must be disjoint, no later override is permitted, and the resulting complete object is the schema-validation and persisted-record vector.

candidate_subject_contract.result_binding_independence: The complete fourteen-field subject fingerprint is computed before and without the exact-result binding.

candidate_final_contract.approval_rule: Every new approval binds the final candidate 1.3 ref and candidate_fingerprint after the complete exact-result binding is included.

validation_result_contract.persisted_encoding: RFC8785-JCS complete record plus one LF
validation_result_contract.exact_document_identity: No result self-hash exists. Exact result bytes are selected only by the downstream candidate 1.3 validation_result_binding.

active_observation_ordering_vectors.ordering_authority: exact active_observation_refs array order in the current committed lifecycle-transition head
active_observation_ordering_vectors.writer_order_rule: ascending tuple of lifecycle event precedence then event_fingerprint; validation copies the retained committed-head order without ref sorting
active_observation_ordering_vectors.retained_head_compatibility: Existing immutable multi-observation lifecycle heads remain byte-authoritative in their recorded array order. Candidate 1.3 evaluation copies that order exactly and does not rewrite, migrate, or ref-sort the head. Missing, duplicate, reordered, incomplete, or excess result or intent entries refuse before mutation.

candidate_exact_result_binding_contract.semantic_binding: validation_result_ref and validation_result_fingerprint identify the independently recomputed lifecycle-validation result 1.0 semantic record
candidate_exact_result_binding_contract.exact_document_binding: result_document_sha256 is SHA-256 of the exact persisted complete result RFC8785-JCS UTF-8 bytes plus one LF; result_byte_length counts every byte including that LF

historical_candidate_1_2_contract.migration_rule: Preserve every candidate 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2 record and approval byte; never copy its result ref or approval into candidate 1.3 authority.

edges: result semantic identity plus engine audit timestamp -> exact persisted result JCS+LF bytes
result ref/fingerprint and exact bytes hash/length -> candidate 1.3 exact-result binding
candidate subject plus subject fingerprint plus complete exact-result binding -> final candidate fingerprint/ID
final candidate fingerprint and semantic result ref/fingerprint -> intent 1.2 candidate_lineage
forbidden_edges: lifecycle-validation result record -> final candidate fingerprint field or candidate ID back-reference
identity_graph.acyclic_proof: Every dependency advances strictly through topological_order. Exact result bytes intentionally feed the candidate 1.3 binding and final identity, but the result 1.0 record itself contains only candidate_subject_fingerprint and no final-candidate field or back-reference.

author_replay_contract.lock: Hold the author lock for the complete read-only inventory, recomputation, classification, and any permitted first-authoring publication.
recomputation_order: independently recompute the complete candidate 1.3 subject fingerprint without any result binding
resolve current profile, all definitions, intake/content, canonical basis, lifecycle policy/head/state, active observations, and reopened coverage
independently recompute the expected lifecycle-validation result 1.0 semantic fingerprint and ref without validated_at_utc
perform the exact two-pass bounded no-follow candidate/result inventory in author_inventory_contract before mutation
author_replay_contract.discovery_scope_rule: Classify every immediate entry in both owned roots under author_inventory_contract. Count only safe schema-valid candidate 1.3 records matching the recomputed pair; safe historical/nonmatching records are retained nonmatches, while any unsafe/malformed/unowned entry or stable-scan disagreement refuses before mutation.
author_replay_contract.refusal_rule: Missing, unsafe, rewritten, duplicate, mismatching, semantically crossed, or raw-document-crossed authority refuses before any timestamp allocation, create-new, overwrite, repair, adoption, deletion, or cleanup.

orphan_and_recovery_contract.publication_order: After complete preflight, first authoring publishes the immutable result create-new, reopens and computes its exact JCS+LF SHA-256/length, constructs final candidate 1.3, then publishes the candidate create-new.
orphan_and_recovery_contract.orphan_definition: The expected semantic result exists but no candidate 1.3 matches the independently recomputed candidate-subject and semantic-result pair.
orphan_and_recovery_contract.minimal_recovery: Preserve every byte and refuse. Resolution requires a separately authorized forensic procedure.
orphan_and_recovery_contract.automatic_crash_completion: Out of scope. If desired, stop and specify a separately reviewed author-publication transaction; no recovery protocol is inferred here.

author_inventory_contract.author_lock_scope: one exclusive repository-identity plus target-instance author lock spans both complete scans, classification, and any permitted first-authoring publication
author_inventory_contract.store_alignment_rule: validation_result_store is exactly the directory parent of the unchanged lifecycle-validation-result 1.0 store_path_rule; semantic result refs resolve to the same basename in that authoritative store, and no evidence-root alias exists
author_inventory_contract.enumeration: Open each exact root no-follow with reparse/link rejection; enumerate every immediate entry without glob filtering; sort by raw ASCII filename bytes; reject nested directories and every non-regular entry; duplicate-key parse and closed-schema validate every bounded file.

classification.safe_candidate_1.0_1.1_1.2: historical evidence; never a match or fallback
classification.safe_candidate_1.3_nonmatching_pair: unrelated retained candidate; never a match
classification.safe_result_1.0_nonexpected_semantic_ref: unrelated retained result; never an orphan for this request
classification.matching_candidate_1.3: count by independently recomputed subject plus semantic-result ref/fingerprint pair
classification.expected_semantic_result: classify absent, safe exact, or present-not-exact
classification.unsafe_or_malformed_any_version_or_unown: refuse before mutation even when historical or otherwise unrelated

author_inventory_contract.stable_scan: Perform two complete bounded reads under the author lock. Each scan records root file identity plus every (raw filename bytes, file identity, byte length, SHA-256) tuple. Require byte-identical tuple vectors and revalidated record identities; any add/remove/rename/identity/length/hash/root change refuses before mutation.
author_inventory_contract.overflow: Count, per-file, aggregate-byte, filename-byte, arithmetic-overflow, or second-scan mismatch refuses before timestamp allocation or filesystem mutation and preserves every entry.
